dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Last year, I wrote a short văn bản about Vietnamese Tet. But no one believed that a Russian like me could hiểu your culture.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Really? I'd love to read that văn bản. Tet is a special kỳ nghỉ for us Vietnamese. But I think someone smart like you can hiểu any culture.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Don't flatter me! That văn bản was just a small exercise. But... if you really want to read it, I can send it to you. I also wrote about the Russian kỳ nghỉ Maslenitsa. Do you know about that?

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: I've never heard of Maslenitsa. But I love learning about kỳ nghỉ from other cultures. Perhaps... instead of just reading your văn bản, we could experience some traditional celebrations together? I know a Russian restaurant in District 1...

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Are you... asking me out? Russian restaurants in Saigon usually don't have the right flavor. I could cook traditional blini for Maslenitsa. But don't misunderstand! This is not a date...
